title: Why a Plane's 'Black Box' Is Orange
description:
Aircraft 'black boxes' are flight recorders painted bright orange to help recovery. There are usually two: cockpit voice and flight data. They're built to standards like 3,400 g impact and 1,000°C+ fire.
